summary: Join our specialized training to tackle informal employment challenges in social protection. Gain valuable insights and practical tools for effective solutions.
lede: Social protection for informal workers explores ways to extend coverage beyond systems designed around formal employment. The course is for policy professionals, program managers, and advocates working on social protection or employment. Participants learn to identify policy gaps, assess financing feasibility, and develop contributory or non-contributory schemes with practical approaches to registration and benefit delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who influence, design, or implement social protection and employment policies, including:
audience: Policy analysts and advisors in ministries
Program managers and coordinators in social protection
Trade union officials and informal worker associations
Local government and social welfare officers
Monitoring and evaluation specialists in social programs
Social insurance administrators and extension officers
Gender and inclusion specialists in the development
modules: Financing and Fiscal Space for Inclusion
Integrating Informal Employment into National Policy Frameworks
Monitoring and Evaluation for Inclusive Systems
